# Self-hosted libraries

Loaded from this folder so the dashboard does not depend on third-party CDNs at runtime.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Loaded |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `d3.min.js` | D3 | 7.9.0 | ISC | every page |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | topojson-client | 3.1.0 | ISC | every page (map) |
| `countries-110m.json` | world-atlas | 2.0.2 | ISC | map only |
| `lucide.min.js` | Lucide | 0.468.0 | ISC | not loaded; source for the subset |
| `lucide-icons.js` | Lucide subset | 0.468.0 | ISC | every page; generated by `npm run build-icons` |
| `xlsx.full.min.js` | SheetJS Community Edition | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 | only when exporting to Excel |

SheetJS 0.18.5 has published advisories for *reading* untrusted spreadsheets; the dashboard only *writes* workbooks, so they do not apply, but upgrade if spreadsheet import is ever added.
